Name: Kantrip's Hi-Res Older Sam Portraits
Author: Kantrip
Description:
[color=#6d9eeb][size=5][b]Description[/b][/size][/color]

[size=3]I've been wanting an older-looking Sam for a while now ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32737]here's my first attempt[/url]). Although facial expressions continue to be very difficult, I am *much* happier with this second version, and feel like it deserves its own mod.[/size]

[size=3](I do not use generative AI for any of my work, including visual stuff like Portraits. All of the images in this mod were created by me using Procreate, and I struggled through every single one of these facial expressions the hard way xD)[/size]

[color=#6d9eeb][size=5][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/color]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]﻿ (and its requirements) [/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24534]PortraiturePlus[/url]﻿, for seasonal outfits (this mod includes a winter portrait)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Create a new folder inside Mods/Portraiture. Call it whatever you want; I call mine "Kantrip"[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Unzip this mod and choose a portrait set from the ones listed above. Paste all four .png files into your new Portraiture folder
- Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/Kantrip  ﻿﻿/Sam.png﻿ ﻿/Sam_Beach.png ﻿﻿/Sam_JojaMart.png﻿ /Sam_Winter.png﻿﻿[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b]NOTE: ﻿[/b]If you are using this in conjunction with DCBurger and want to replace the existing Sam, paste your portraits directly into:[/size]
[size=3][b] - Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/DCBurger[/b][/size]
